div.p: Bootstrap 5.3 for GWT: every Bootstrap component as a widget you can use from Java and UiBinder, plus extras for date pickers, rich text, selects, sliders and more. Every page of this demo shows the widgets running, next to the UiBinder code that creates them.

ul.li: Choices.js and Slim Select draw the selects too, besides Tom Select: the Select page switches between the three.
Each date picker and select engine is its own module: an app only compiles the engines it inherits.
The Bootstrap 5.3 options and classes that had no API: gutters, responsive tables, stacked progress bars, validation success messages, tooltip and dropdown options.
jQuery 4 in the extras, with jQuery Migrate only for Summernote and the color picker.
StickyHelper for Bootstrap's sticky positions, also from a breakpoint up.
Bootbox.init runs its callback for every dialog, and dialogs take show and hide callbacks.
Tom Select 2.6.2, Font Awesome 7.3.1, Air Datepicker 3.6.0 and jQuery UI 1.14.2.
